title: Claude Code frontmatter of skills, subagents, and output styles (Claude Code 2.1.307)
$comment: For the YAML header of skill/command, subagent, and output style .md files. Generated from Claude Code 2.1.307 by tools/schemas/code.ts. Anchors: "tengu_frontmatter_shadow_unknown_key" and the table {skill, agent, "output-style"} of strict zod objects next to it; descriptions are the program's .describe() text; the loose value type of most keys (string, number, boolean, or null) is why they are x-unverified. Keys with a description that starts with "@internal" are internal. No probe in captures/ records frontmatter keys. Do not edit by hand.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the filename without extension.

description.description: One-line summary shown in listings and the Skill tool.

model.description: Model override (`haiku`, `sonnet`, `opus`, `fable`, or a full ID). Use `inherit` to match the parent conversation.

allowed-tools.description: Tools available to the model while this file is active. Comma-separated string or YAML list.

disallowed-tools.description: Tools removed from the model while this file is active. Comma-separated string or YAML list. Cleared when the user sends the next message.

argument-hint.description: Placeholder text shown after the slash command name.

arguments.description: @internal — typed variant of argument-hint; argument-hint is the documented form

disable-model-invocation.description: If true, the model cannot invoke this via the Skill tool; only users can type the slash command.

user-invocable.description: If false, hides the slash command from users; only the model can invoke it via the Skill tool.

effort.description: Thinking effort for the model: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `max`, or an integer.

shell.description: Shell for `!`-command blocks: `bash` or `powershell`. Defaults to bash regardless of platform.

when_to_use.description: Guidance for when the model should reach for this skill. Becomes part of the tool description.

paths.description: Glob patterns this skill applies to. The skill only loads when the model touches matching files.

hooks.description: Hooks registered while this skill is active. Same shape as settings.json `hooks`.

context.description: Where the skill runs: `inline` expands into the current conversation; `fork` spawns a subagent.

agent.description: Agent type to spawn when `context: fork`.

background.description: Only for `context: fork`. Forks run as background agents that report back as a task notification instead of blocking the turn; set `false` to keep the caller waiting for the result in-line.

fallback.description: @internal — interim defense-in-depth for thin-pointer skill stubs. If true, this skill yields to a same-suffix plugin or MCP skill (`<plugin>:<name>` / `<server>:<name>`) when one is loaded. Stubs carrying this should be deleted once their canonical plugin/MCP skill ships, not maintained.

metadata.description: Free-form map for the skill author's own use (e.g. entitlement or catalog fields). Preserved on the loaded skill.

skill.$comment: Skills and commands (.md files with a YAML header).

name.description: Agent identifier. Required — this is how the Agent tool and `--agent` flag address it.

description.description: When to use this agent. Required — shown in the Agent tool listing.

model.description: Model override for this agent. Use `inherit` to match the spawning conversation.

tools.description: Tools available to this agent. Replaces the default set.

disallowedTools.description: Tools removed from the default set. Ignored if `tools` is set.

color.description: @internal — display color in the agents UI

permissionMode.description: Permission mode the agent runs in.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers to connect when this agent runs.

hooks.description: Hooks registered while this agent runs.

maxTurns.description: Maximum conversation turns before the agent stops.

initialPrompt.description: Auto-submitted first message when this agent runs as the main session (via `--agent` or settings). Not read when spawned as a subagent.

background.description: If true, the agent runs in the background by default.

omitClaudeMd.description: If true, the agent runs without the user, project and local CLAUDE.md instruction files when spawned as a subagent; managed policy files are kept. For agents that take everything they need from the delegation prompt.

isolation.description: Filesystem isolation: `worktree` runs in a temporary git worktree.

observer.description: Agent type auto-spawned as a background observer whenever this agent runs.

observerMessage.description: Supplemental postamble appended (after the harness-owned default) to each activity digest sent to the observer.

observeSubagents.description: If false, subagents this agent spawns do not inherit its observer. Defaults to true.

experimental.description: Experimental per-agent options; unknown keys are ignored.

agent.$comment: Subagent files (.md with a YAML header).

name.description: Style name used in the Output style picker in `/config` and in settings. Defaults to the filename.

description.description: Shown in the Output style picker in `/config`.

keep-coding-instructions.description: If true, the default coding instructions stay in the system prompt alongside this style.

force-for-plugin.description: @internal — only meaningful for plugin-bundled styles; ignored for user styles

output-style.$comment: Output style files (.md with a YAML header).
